sections.text: A storm has silenced the clockwork lighthouse. Without its beam, a merchant ship will strike the black reef before dawn. The lighthouse door is locked, but a narrow path climbs toward an open window.

options.description: Climb the rain-slick path to the window

consequence.text: Loose stone cuts your hands as you climb.

sections.text: Inside the lantern room, jammed brass gears groan beneath the dark lens. You can force the mechanism or descend to find the missing counterweight.

consequence.text: The mechanism snaps back with crushing force.

sections.text: Beneath a pile of charts you find the keeper's winding key and a flask of restorative tonic.

options.description: Drink the tonic and enter through the service door

consequence.text: Warmth returns to your exhausted limbs.

sections.text: The counterweight hangs over a flooded shaft. The winding key fits a socket beside the release lever.

options.description: Wind the mechanism with the keeper's key
Leap across the shaft and pull the lever

consequence.text: You strike the far ledge hard, but keep your grip.

sections.text: The broken gears collapse. The lighthouse remains dark as the storm closes in.
The great lens turns. A golden beam sweeps across the reef, and the distant ship changes course just in time.
